title: Deposit Balances on Moved In-Person Appointments
content:
## Rule

When a patient moves an open In-Person Appointments visit that holds a booking deposit, the deposit is carried to the new slot and the deposit the moved visit requires is worked out again; where it exceeds the deposit held on the visit, the patient pays the difference by card as a further deposit entry on the same visit, and that balance stays owed while the visit is open and is worked out on the day it is paid.

| Situation of the moved visit | Result |
|---|---|
| Deposit the moved visit requires exceeds the deposit held | The difference is owed and paid by card as a further deposit entry on the same visit, dated the day it is paid |
| Deposit the moved visit requires does not exceed the deposit held | No balance is owed |

## The card payment tool

**Capability.** `pay_deposit_balance_07a1fa0e` is the patient's own payment, by their own debit or credit card, of a deposit balance still owed on one of their open in-person appointments that already holds a deposit. One further deposit-collection entry paid by card, dated today and carrying the visit's encounter number, is added to the appointment's fee and deposit history, and the deposit shown as held on the appointment rises by the amount paid.

**Invocation.** A customer-side tool: it is unlocked and handed over to the patient, and the customer themselves runs `pay_deposit_balance_07a1fa0e`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `appointment_id` | Reference number of the patient's open in-person appointment the balance is paid on, as the agent reads it out from the appointment list | Identifier |
| `amount` | The deposit balance the patient pays | US dollars, a positive number with exactly 2 decimal places (cents), stored as given |

**Return.** A payment receipt with `appointment_event_id` (the payment receipt number), `appointment_id` (the visit the balance is paid on), `payment_method` (always "card"), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places) and `deposit_held_usd` (the deposit held on the visit after the payment, USD with 2 decimal places). The presence of `appointment_event_id` confirms the payment was taken; afterwards the patient sees the higher deposit held on the visit.
